text:
Alert 1 - Situation: India-wide advisory: at major airports and train stations, unsolicited offers of cheap hotel transport can lead to overpriced hotel rooms or tours, long high-fee cab rides, or pressure to pay. How to avoid: Book accommodation ahead; use a prepaid taxi, a reputable app, or a known travel agent. Confirm the destination and total fare before boarding, and use the airport help counter if unsure. Fair-price hint: No city-wide fair fare was verified. Ask for the posted fare chart or use the meter, and confirm the total before the ride.
Alert 2 - Situation: India-wide advisory: people at stations or tourist sites may offer tickets, tours, or guiding services outside official counters or recognized agencies; such offers can result in extra charges or unwanted services. How to avoid: Buy entry tickets at the authorized counter and arrange guides through a recognized agency, hotel, or official tourism office. Verify the service and price before agreeing. Fair-price hint: No reliable city-wide guide price was verified. Check the official ticket rate or get the guide's full fee in writing before starting.
Alert 3 - Situation: India-wide advisory: shopping scams can involve carpets, jewellery, or gemstones that are not as represented, along with pressure to buy or deals that sound unusually good. How to avoid: Compare reputable businesses, inspect the item and its description, and do not hand over money or a card until satisfied with the purchase. Avoid transporting goods for strangers. Fair-price hint: No universal fair price was verified. Compare like-for-like items at reputable sellers and request an itemized receipt; avoid treating a pressured or unusually cheap offer as a benchmark.
